purpose: Provide one multi-perspective orchestration surface for both specialist tournaments and stepwise creation: build need-specific specialist pools, learn contextual finalist-vote fit, form broad team combinations, and advance selected work through explicit microsteps with perspective analysis before and after every meaningful result even when the whole run is fast.

properties.operation: specialist operations: prepare/build-pool, rank/select-finalists, record-vote, inspect-fit; stepwise operations: prepare, start, checkpoint, record-analysis, execute, record-result, split, replan, instant, inspect
properties.challenge: specialist path: concrete challenge or need to inspect from many perspectives
properties.criteria: specialist path: optional weighted judging criteria
properties.pool_size: specialist or stepwise path: specialist profile bound
properties.team_size: specialist planning path: 3..6 members per team
properties.max_teams: specialist/planning path: bounded team field up to 512
properties.tournament: specialist rank path: exact digest-bound prepared tournament
properties.judgements: specialist rank path: independent evidence-backed scores keyed by team_id
properties.ranking: specialist vote path: exact digest-bound complete ranking with two shown finalists
properties.winner_team_id: specialist vote path: explicit choice of one shown finalist
properties.limit: specialist fit path: maximum history rows
properties.request: stepwise prepare path: optional ordinary machine request used to attach deterministic anatomy/direction decomposition
properties.workflow: stepwise path: exact digest-bound axm.stepwise-perspective-workflow/v0.1 state
properties.checkpoint: stepwise path: exact prepared pre/post checkpoint
properties.analyses: stepwise path: executor-supplied perspective analyses keyed by prepared specialist ids
properties.result: stepwise path: external JSON-serializable result for analysis-only or externally executed steps
properties.evidence: stepwise path: explicit evidence references for an external result
properties.substeps: stepwise split path: two or more smaller replacement steps
properties.replacement_steps: stepwise replan path: replacement remaining plan
properties.step_records: stepwise instant path: chronological pre analyses, result and post analyses per step
properties.perspective_pool_size: stepwise instant path: checkpoint perspective bound

contains: detailed universal and need-derived specialist profiles
isolated parallel challenge packets and exact top-two finalist state
digest-bound explicit step plans and workflow cursor
best/middle/low/random perspective checkpoints before and after meaningful steps
chronological receipts that preserve plan -> pre-analysis -> action/result -> post-analysis -> advance even for instant execution

relationships: keeps specialist competition and stepwise perspective cadence in one orchestration body instead of growing duplicate top-level coordination systems
universal perspective profiles combine with challenge-matched master-registry specialists so the eyes change with the need
historical +1 votes are contextual fit evidence, not universal intelligence or authority
best, middle, lowest-third and mixed-random perspectives continue to challenge accumulated winners
the stepwise path uses those different eyes before and after each meaningful step rather than only once at the beginning
broad work can be recursively split into smaller dependency-ordered steps whenever a supplied checkpoint identifies unresolved independent work
a step may invoke an already live creation capability without bypassing that capability's own boundaries
fast wall-clock execution never removes logical chronology from the workflow receipt
the engine never claims prepared specialist packets reasoned until a cognition provider, human or other executor supplies actual analysis/evidence
AXM-CAP-LOCAL-CREATION-PROVIDER can explicitly execute a prepared stepwise checkpoint through one loopback cognition provider and return it to this capability's existing deterministic validator

anatomy_refs.basis: The live capability summons bounded need-specific specialist pools, forms many combinations and emits evidence-bearing orchestration state.
Every specialist is an inspectable bounded working profile with explicit temperament, strengths, blind spots, evidence preference, disagreement style and domain focus.
Stepwise preparation runs multi-perspective planning and validates the selected explicit dependency-ordered step plan before execution.
The stepwise runtime advances through typed workflow states and bounded transitions including split, replan, hold and completion.
Every unit of work is an explicit step with one purpose, expected evidence, stop condition, dependencies and result state.

limitations: specialist personalities are method overlays, not independent identities, consciousness, expertise proof or execution authority

the deterministic orchestration engine prepares perspective work but does not fake arbitrary semantic reasoning; actual analyses/submissions require an executor, with one explicit local-provider path now available for stepwise checkpoints
+1 votes estimate observed contextual team fit and can be biased by exposure or judging quality; zero points can mean untested rather than bad
combination exploration is bounded to 512 teams per tournament and may sample rather than enumerate the full combinatorial space
recursive step splitting is bounded to depth 8 and 128 total steps
instant staged execution preserves logical chronology in receipts but does not imply wall-clock delay between stages
a step with no live capability route holds rather than inventing execution
historical votes and workflow checkpoints do not modify CANON, permissions or execution authority
persistent_state: specialist finalist votes accumulate in state/specialist-fit.json; stepwise workflow state is carried explicitly by the caller in v0

truth.basis: Prepared perspective packets are separated from actual analysis, incomplete tournament judging remains visible, and every step/checkpoint/result/transition stays explicit and digest-bound.

agency.basis: Historical winners never become permanent authority; plans remain selectable/revisable and middle/low/mixed perspectives continue challenging current best-fit views.

continuity.basis: Fit history persists as an inspectable local ledger while stepwise workflow state preserves a chronological timeline, completed steps and retired/replanned evidence.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Different perspectives are explored before selection and around each meaningful action; fast execution cannot silently skip logical pre-analysis or post-analysis boundaries.
